div.div: 4 أَفْكَهَتْ She (a camel) yielded her milk plentifully on the occasion of eating the [herbage called] رَبِيع, before her bringing forth: (S, TA:) or she being near to bringing forth, her صَلَوَانِ [app. meaning two parts on the right and left of the tail (see صَلًا in art. صلو)] became lax, or flaccid, and her udder became large; like أَفَكَّت. (TA in art. فك. [See also the part. n., below.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
